releaseNotes: Re-releases the validated V720 runtime baseline as V722 after full rollback of V721.
No functional runtime changes were introduced relative to V720; only release/version metadata was promoted to 1.0.0.722.

en: Re-released the validated V720 runtime baseline as V722 after discarding the V721 changes.
Retains the V720 startup No-device artwork reset and ICA Tier toggle UI exactly as the rollback baseline; no V721 runtime changes are included.
ko: V721 변경사항을 전부 폐기하고 검증된 V720 런타임 기준본을 V722로 재릴리즈합니다.
V720의 시작 시 No device 이미지 잔존 제거 및 ICA Tier 토글 UI를 그대로 유지하며, V721 런타임 변경은 포함하지 않습니다.
